info.title: Trellis Staff API
info.description: Course-scoped staff automation. Assignments are lesson/section containers; parts are activities. IDs remain stable across edits. Content writes create drafts with explicit publishing; title-only batch updates are immediate. Student work is preserved. No SQL or arbitrary grader Python execution endpoint exists.

get.summary: Read private submission review metrics
get.description: Staff-only review aid; not an AI probability and never an automatic grade decision. Requires both activity:read and submissions:read. Page numbering starts at zero, with 50 students per page.

200.description: Paginated students, metric contributions, reasons, code observations, review notes and analysis coverage.

403.description: Missing staff role or required scopes.

get.summary: Export a private student review worksheet
get.description: Active course staff only; requires activity:read, submissions:read and roster:read. Returns all matching active students, not one page. JSON includes text GTIDs, raw metric values, contributions, formula maps and missing-data coverage. Does not send anything to Microsoft. Use format=csv for Excel-compatible download. No emails or staff notes are exported.

200.description: Worksheet rows, headers and Excel-invariant formula map, or UTF-8 CSV.

403.description: Inactive/nonstaff membership, wrong course or missing scopes.

patch.summary: Rename one or more part titles atomically
patch.description: Immediate title-only update. Requires current expected_title for every part; conflicts reject the entire batch. Content revisions, files, submissions and grades are unchanged.

200.description: All titles updated; returns updated and results

403.description: Missing content:write scope

404.description: Part is unavailable in this course

409.description: An expected title is stale; no changes applied

FileWrite.description: Send exactly one of text or content_base64. New files require visibility. Existing-file PUT may omit visibility to preserve it. Files are limited to 1 MB.

items.description: Native blocks: paragraph, document, code, image, multiple_choice, select_all, fill_blank, numeric, coding, kaltura, video, placeholder. Rich text is structured nodes, not HTML or flattened Markdown.

grading.description: Shallow merge. A supplied native questions or definition value replaces that entire object.

PartPatch.description: Content, grading and file changes create a draft; part title, ordering and metadata apply immediately.

files.description: Public text fixtures written fresh for this case; included in full_results.txt.

argument_constructors.description: Argument index to a class declared in the sandbox source. Converts lists of attribute records into class instances.

clock.description: Optional reproducible clock, applied only within this isolated test.

items.description: action, target, arguments (generator descriptors), variables (generator descriptors), optional text files (generator descriptors), argument_constructors, tolerance and strip_output. Optional steps, clock, comparison, or a combined inputs generator (arguments/variables/files/steps). python comparison preserves stripped strings and four-decimal float equality; module_outcome observes intentional exceptions.

random_cases.description: Fresh inputs per submission. Supported generators: literal, integer, float, choice, string, list, sequence, record and join. Input expansion is bounded. Expected results are observed in a separate isolated reference run; errors do not record a zero grade. Transform generators support bounded str, chr, add, multiply and round operations. Correlated inputs and public observation traces are supported.

reference_source.description: Private independent Python reference for randomized cases; executed only in an isolated container.

external_ids.description: Known gtid, gt_username and sis_user_id values. Never inferred from a Canvas numeric ID.
